extra-001834a22f86.zh-Hans: 15秒写实巨龙变身提示词 创作一段15秒超写实电影级奇幻序列，一位20多岁的成年女性在茂密神秘森林深处一条清澈见底的河边玩弄一只小玩具龙。场景与角色：一位20多岁美丽的成年女性，自然外貌，真实的皮肤质感，飘逸长发，穿着简单的土色调休闲装。她坐在森林浅河边光滑的岩石上，手中俏皮地拿着一只小巧、细节丰富的玩具龙。环境感觉完全真实且沉浸：茂密的绿色枝叶、覆满苔藓的岩石、透过树木洒下的柔和阳光、漂浮的尘埃颗粒、真实的水流运动和自然的空气透视。0–4秒：以电影级中景开始，女性坐在河边，自然地微笑着玩弄那只小龙。她轻轻地在空中移动玩具，仿佛让它飞翔。使用微妙的手持镜头运动和真实的环境声音。阳光在她的头发和水面上形成柔和的高光。4–7秒：她慢慢地把玩具龙放入浅河水中，短暂地将它完全浸入水下。当玩具触水时，在它周围产生微妙但真实的涟漪和小波浪。女性好奇地注视着。7–11秒——变身：水突然开始发出微妙的神秘能量光芒。小龙在水面下开始膨胀。它的身体迅速生长，同时保持真实的解剖结构和物理运动。鳞片自然地在其身体上形成，翅膀展开，爪子伸出，长尾巴扫过水面。变身应感觉物理上可信且照片级写实，而非卡通化。当生物从一只小玩具成长为一条巨大、威严的巨龙时，水自然地飞溅。11–15秒：巨龙从河中戏剧性地升起，高耸于女性之上。水从它巨大的鳞片和翅膀上倾泻而下。它展开巨大的翅膀，发出一声强大但真实的咆哮，在森林中回荡。女性带着真正的惊叹后退，同时保持自然、可信的反应。以广角电影镜头结束，展现女性、巨龙、河流和周围森林，营造出令人惊叹的比例感。视觉风格：超写实真人奇幻，好莱坞级电影VFX，物理精确的水模拟，真实的龙解剖结构，细致的单片鳞片，自然的皮肤和头发质感，体积阳光，真实阴影，空气透视，微妙的胶片颗粒，高动态范围，真实的动态模糊，全画幅电影摄影机质感，35mm镜头，适当处的浅景深，自然调色，高度详细的环境，角色和生物无缝一致。重要：在整个视频中保持女性的外貌、发型、服装和面部特征一致。在变身过程中保持龙的设计一致。变身必须平滑连续地进行，在实际变身过程中没有剪辑。避免卡通美学、动漫、CGI感的塑料质感、夸张的面部表情、不自然的身体运动、闪烁、变形伪影、多余肢体、畸形的解剖结构或突兀的场景变化。

new-132.zh-Hans: 视频prompt：时间段:0-1.8秒 画面:年轻亚洲男主佩戴银色头戴式耳机，身穿灰色连帽棒球服、深色长裤，正面坐在打开的窗台上。他突然向后仰，头肩先下沉，双腿越过窗框，直接倒出窗外，不做完整后空翻。运镜:稳定对称的中大全景;男主后倒时，摄影机迅速前推并向下俯冲，穿过窗口跟随人物。 时间段:1.8-3.2秒 画面:窗台距离街道不高，男主短暂下坠，湿润街道与车辆迅速放大。他将身体调整为斜向前方，抬手朝建筑高处射出蛛丝。蛛丝瞬间绷紧，将下坠转化为向前摆荡，与耳机没有任何连接。运镜:贴近人物俯冲，通过短促甩镜进入手腕近景;蛛丝绷紧后沿牵引方向加速，转为贴近街面的追拍。 时间段:3.2-5.7秒 画面:男主沿街道完成一次流畅的钟摆式摆荡，从车辆上方低空掠过。身体顺着惯性自然延伸，衣服和头发受到气流吹动。到达最低点后迅速加速，随后松开蛛丝向前滑行，全程不翻转。运镜:摄影机在侧后方低空追随，沿摆荡弧线先下降再抬升，车辆和路灯快速掠过前景。 时间段:5.7-8秒 画面：顺着惯性向前方（类似物抛物线逻辑）至身体微微下降时，男主立刻再次抬手朝另一侧建筑高处射出蛛丝，蛛丝再次瞬间绷紧，（画面微自然加速）将下坠转化为向前摆荡，与耳机没有任何连接。运镜:贴近人物侧面平移快速跟拍，通过短促甩镜进入手腕近景;蛛丝绷紧后沿牵引方向加速，转为贴近街面的追拍。。 时间段:8～10.3秒 画面:男主贴近建筑外墙滑行，双脚依次踩上墙面和金属消防梯，完成两次快速蹬墙，随后跃向街道。动作具有明确受力与反弹，不进行空翻。运镜:贴近墙面侧向追拍，短暂靠近鞋底落点，再跟随人物向下移动。 时间段:10.3-12.8秒 画面:镜头先呈现湿润人行道的低机位空镜，男主的影子掠入，随后双脚从画面上方落下。棕色靴子落地并溅起少量水花，膝盖自然缓冲，男主立即起身向前奔跑。运镜:落地前保持贴地固定机位;双脚触地后镜头轻微震动，迅速向上摇摄，再转为低机位侧后方追拍。 时间段:12.8-17秒 画面:男主继续奔跑，一辆黄色出租车从镜头前方驶过并短暂遮挡。车辆移开后，男主已经来到道路另一侧，踩住低矮护栏向前跃起，同时射出第3道蛛丝，蛛丝迅速绷紧，男主连接蛛丝的手用力一拉，整个身体被迅速牵引向建筑屋顶，双脚再次踩上墙面，完成两次快速蹬墙，随后跃向建筑楼顶。运镜:低机位追拍，利用出租车完成遮挡;随后侧向跟随男主跃起并向上仰拍，利用建筑墙面掠过衔接屋顶。 时间段:17-19.2秒 画面:男主落在屋顶水洼旁，以低位蹲姿缓冲，一只手触碰水面，产生克制的水花与涟漪。他缓慢起身，先看向摄影机，再平静地望向远处城市。运镜:从低位中景平稳上升并轻微前推至中近景;男主转头时镜头停止移动。 时间段：19.2-20.8秒 画面:男主转身面向纽约天际线。摄影机移动至侧后方并拉远，由人物中近景扩大为屋顶大全景，远处高楼与尖顶摩天楼进入画面，最后停留半秒并自然淡出。运镜:稳定后拉并轻微横移，最后固定机位停留。
new-132.en: Video prompt: Time segment: 0-1.8 seconds. Image: A young Asian male protagonist wearing silver over-ear headphones, a gray hooded baseball jacket, and dark trousers, sitting facing forward on an open windowsill. He suddenly leans backward, head and shoulders sinking first, legs crossing over the window frame, and falls straight out of the window without doing a complete backflip. Camera movement: Stable symmetrical medium-wide shot; when the male protagonist leans backward, the camera rapidly pushes in and dives downward, passing through the window to follow the character. Time segment: 1.8-3.2 seconds. Image: The windowsill is not high above the street; the male protagonist falls briefly, and the wet street and vehicles rapidly enlarge. He adjusts his body to an oblique forward orientation and raises a hand to shoot a web line toward a high point on the building. The web line instantly pulls taut, converting the fall into a forward swing, with no connection whatsoever to the headphones. Camera movement: Dive close to the character, entering a close-up of the wrist through a short whip pan; after the web line pulls taut, accelerate along the traction direction, transitioning to a tracking shot close to the street surface. Time segment: 3.2-5.7 seconds. Image: The male protagonist completes one smooth pendulum-style swing along the street, skimming low over vehicles. His body naturally extends with inertia, and his clothes and hair are blown by the airflow. After reaching the lowest point, he rapidly accelerates, then releases the web line and glides forward, without flipping throughout. Camera movement: The camera follows from the side-rear at low altitude, first descending then rising along the swing arc, with vehicles and streetlights rapidly sweeping past the foreground. Time segment: 5.7-8 seconds. Image: Following inertia forward (similar to projectile parabola logic) until the body slightly descends, the male protagonist immediately raises his hand again to shoot a web line toward a high point on a building on the other side; the web line instantly pulls taut again, (the image naturally accelerates slightly) converting the fall into a forward swing, with no connection whatsoever to the headphones. Camera movement: Rapid tracking close to the character's side with lateral movement, entering a close-up of the wrist through a short whip pan; after the web line pulls taut, accelerate along the traction direction, transitioning to a tracking shot close to the street surface.. Time segment: 8-10.3 seconds. Image: The male protagonist glides close to the building's exterior wall, stepping onto the wall and a metal fire escape with his feet in sequence, completing two rapid wall kicks, then leaping toward the street. The action has clear force application and rebound, without performing a flip. Camera movement: Lateral tracking close to the wall, briefly approaching the sole landing points, then following the character downward. Time segment: 10.3-12.8 seconds. Image: The shot first presents a low-angle empty shot of the wet sidewalk; the male protagonist's shadow sweeps in, then both feet fall from above the frame. Brown boots land and splash a small amount of water; knees cushion naturally, and the male protagonist immediately rises and runs forward. Camera movement: Keep a fixed ground-level camera before landing; after the feet touch the ground, the camera shakes slightly, rapidly tilts up, then transitions to a low-angle side-rear tracking shot. Time segment: 12.8-17 seconds. Image: The male protagonist continues running; a yellow taxi drives across the front of the lens and briefly blocks the view. After the vehicle moves away, the male protagonist has already reached the other side of the road, steps on a low guardrail and leaps forward while shooting a 3rd web line; the web line rapidly pulls taut, the male protagonist's hand connected to the web line pulls hard, and his entire body is rapidly pulled toward the building rooftop; his feet step onto the wall again, completing two rapid wall kicks, then he leaps toward the building rooftop. Camera movement: Low-angle tracking shot, using the taxi for occlusion; then laterally follow the male protagonist's leap and tilt up, using the building wall sweeping past to connect to the rooftop. Time segment: 17-19.2 seconds. Image: The male protagonist lands beside a rooftop puddle, cushioning in a low crouch, one hand touching the water surface, producing restrained splashes and ripples. He slowly rises, first looking at the camera, then calmly gazing at the distant city. Camera movement: Steadily rise from a low-angle medium shot and push in slightly to a medium close-up; when the male protagonist turns his head, the camera stops moving. Time segment: 19.2-20.8 seconds. Image: The male protagonist turns to face the New York skyline. The camera moves to the side-rear and pulls back, expanding from a medium close-up of the character to a rooftop wide shot; distant high-rises and spired skyscrapers enter the frame, finally holding for half a second and naturally fading out. Camera movement: Steady pullback with slight lateral movement, finally holding at a fixed camera position.

new-218.zh-Hans:
角色一致性：主体为参考图@Image 1中的年轻男性网红。在每个时间段和每个角度，脸型、五官和肤色都必须与@Image 1完全一致。不得改变或扭曲脸部。

服装：在每个场景中，穿着时尚奢华的黑色休闲装、街头服饰或西装。不要穿角色参考图中的服装。每个片段都要完全更换服装和发型。

格式：9:16竖屏。

镜头/风格：快速剪辑节奏，每0.5至1秒切一次。iPhone手持竖拍质感。混合数码变焦推近、拉远和上摇，带有自然的镜头晃动。包含自动对焦拉风箱、室内外光线曝光变化，以及变焦调整时的画质劣化。保留真实皮肤质感，包括毛孔、胡须阴影、飞散碎发和自然皮肤油光。不要使用美颜滤镜、过度皮肤修图、CGI质感或电影级调色。不要合并剪辑或省略场景。不要插入屏幕文字。

声音：时髦的嘻哈或R&B背景音乐，混合街道噪音、脚步声和日常环境声等自然环境音。

---

M-01. 弘大街头表演街 & 纹身店巡游

0至2秒：【弘大步行街】低角度镜头，将自拍杆高高举过头顶，同时快速旋转，在熙熙攘攘的街头表演街中央拍下自己和人群。

2至4秒：【纹身店等候室】特写镜头，用手指指向挂在墙上的纹身图案，随后快速转场到你的脸看向镜头，轻轻咬唇，表情略带紧张。

4至6秒：【纹身工作台】前臂镜头，卷起 oversized 黑色T恤的袖子，快速交叉剪辑到你忍痛微笑的脸部镜头。

6至8秒：【店内镜子前】特写镜头，在镜中检查刚完成的纹身线条，随后你的脸通过镜子与镜头对视，满意地点头。

8至10秒：【弘大巷子】特写镜头，咬一口街头华夫饼，然后因为烫而吹气，同时对着镜头微笑。

10至12秒：【精选店走廊】手持跟拍镜头从背后拍摄，你单肩挎着购物袋慢慢走。画面随脚步自然晃动。

12至15秒：【弘大站入口】在车站出口前，俏皮地向镜头伸出拳头做出碰拳姿势。以正面全身镜头定格在最后一帧结束。
